column2: There shall be exempt from income tax–
the interest accruing to any company, partnership or
other body of persons   outside Sri Lanka, from any
loan granted by that company, partnership or body
of persons to the Government of Sri Lanka or to any
public corporation or to any Government institution
or  to  any  commercial  bank  for  the  time  being
operating in Sri Lanka or to any other undertaking,
if such loan is  approved by the Minister as being
essential for the economic progress of Sri Lanka;
